5.4.0.headline: Your session. Your key.
5.4.0.summary: Bring your own encryption key through config, an environment variable or a Docker secret. Compact auth comes built in.

5.1.0.headline: Buttons are back.
5.1.0.summary: Reply buttons, forms, carousels and booking cards. One API, with structured answers your code can use.

5.0.0.headline: A new foundation.
5.0.0.summary: Three years in the making. A new foundation for everyone coming from v4.

5.3.0.headline: Your session travels light.
5.3.0.summary: Compact authentication is now the default. One encrypted JSON file, with S3 sync and pending-message replay.

5.5.0.headline: Events, live refresh and local stickers
5.5.0.summary: Event cards and RSVPs, refresh controls for running sessions, and local WebP creation with resources loaded on demand.

5.6.1.headline: Node startup, fixed
5.6.1.summary: CommonJS create() now resolves the packaged runtime assets through the ESM core and reaches QR pairing.

5.6.0.headline: Events you can build on
5.6.0.summary: Generated event contracts, signed MCP subscriptions, and familiar callbacks with optional Effect streams.
